text: deployment hardening: dev invite HMAC key fails open in app.py; no HSTS guidance

Done in fe527d5. app.py refuses to boot on an unset or published-default INVITE_HMAC_KEY, with an error naming the generator command. The README's documented dev workflow passes INVITE_HMAC_KEY=dev-key, so it is unaffected - covered by a test. SECRET_KEY left as-is with a comment on why it does not matter (no sessions, no cookies). HSTS: documentation only, added to Deployment requirements, since the blueprint cannot know it was reached over HTTPS.
